newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $23.5 million of Treasury Bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $23.5 million of Treasury Bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold all 475 million rupees ($23.5 million) of treasury bills put on tender during its weekly auction, the central bank said on Thursday.

It sold 120 million rupees of 91-day, 190 million rupees of 182-day and 165 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.23 percent, 9.30 percent and 9.51 percent, respectively, bank officials said.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.61 percent per annum from 9.59 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the Bank of Mauritius sold 436.6 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day Treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.23 percent, 9.32 percent and 9.56 percent, respectively.
